competitions.continuity_claim: The official BAA/NBA lineage is bounded from the 1946-47 first season through the confirmed 2025-26 NBA season.
competitions.source_limitations: The official sources establish lower/current bounds and a future schedule; they do not independently enumerate every intermediate season, and 2026-27 is planning evidence only.

competitions.continuity_claim: The ABA's official nine-season era is bounded from 1967-68 through its final 1975-76 season and is closed before 1976-77 NBA play.
competitions.source_limitations: Official history establishes the league-era bounds and transition only; it does not enumerate endpoint behavior or provider data availability.

competitions.continuity_claim: The WNBA is bounded in its native calendar-year axis from the 1997 inaugural season through the official 2026 season.
competitions.source_limitations: The official formation and schedule sources establish lineage bounds, not endpoint behavior, period-specific response data, or completion of every scheduled game.

competitions.continuity_claim: NBA Summer League event years run from the 2004 debut through the completed 2026 event, excluding the explicit 2011 and 2020 gaps.

competitions.continuity_claim: The NBA G League lineage is bounded from its 2001-02 first season through its official 2025-26 season.
competitions.source_limitations: The official FAQ and schedule establish lower/current bounds only; no 2026-27 G League period is admitted by this leaf, and no endpoint availability is inferred.

revalidation.planned_future_promotion_rule: A planned-future period remains ineligible until a newly retrieved official source independently confirms that period as current or completed and this evidence payload is resealed and rereviewed.
required_checks: confirm every exact URL remains controlled by its recorded authority host
confirm every recorded title and bounded claim remains supported without relying on article-body instructions
confirm explicit Summer League gaps remain exactly 2011 and 2020
confirm no competition-history claim has been promoted into endpoint support or provider availability
confirm no planned-future row has been promoted into confirmed eligibility
retrieve a new official current-bound source whenever a competition advances beyond the recorded last confirmed period
revalidation.trigger: before A1.2c TaskPacket issuance, after any source/title/bound change, and before any refresh that advances a competition period

rights_and_source_limitations: Article and PDF bodies are not reproduced; only source metadata and concise factual claim summaries are retained.
Factual source summaries do not grant redistribution, publication, trademark, or database rights.
Source retrieval did not retain article-body bytes, so claim digests bind the recorded summaries and metadata rather than remote content bytes.
These sources establish competition lineage or event-period existence only and cannot establish endpoint support, provider availability, response contents, or terminal request state.
